Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1961 season.

==Overview==
It was contested by 12 teams, and [[Esbjerg fB]] won the championship. [[Skovshoved IF]] and AI Aarhus, now known as {{ill|Idrætsforeningen AIA-Tranbjerg|dk}} were relegated to the 2nd Division
